title: Only key and title are required
Checkout total ignores the discount on the last line item
subtitle: services/checkout/total.rb in apply_discounts
body:
The cart applies a percentage discount per line item, but the running total is summed before the last discount is subtracted.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Add three items to a cart.
2. Apply a 10% coupon.
3. Observe that the third line's discount is charged at full price.

The fix is to fold the discount into each line before summing, not after. See `apply_discounts` — the accumulator is seeded from the pre-discount subtotal.

title: Session cookie is not marked SameSite
subtitle: middleware/session.rb
body:
The session cookie ships without a `SameSite` attribute, so it rides along on cross-site requests. Set it to `Lax` and confirm the login flow still round-trips.

The tracker already proposed a branch name; the engine will cut exactly that branch because `branch` is set on this item.

title: Typo in the onboarding email subject line
subtitle: templates/email/welcome.txt
body:
The welcome email subject reads "Welcom aboard". One-character fix.

This item carries a distinct `low` badge so that `--sort badge` visibly orders it against the `critical` and `high` items, and `--badge low` selects only it.
